initial_decision.brief_rationale: R217-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the causal effect by standardization over Z. The population-weighted risk difference is (100/250)(32/80−10/20)+(150/250)(81/90−36/60)=0.14.
